records.title: Communication between Frozen Large Language Models via Prompt Optimization in a Referential Game
records.reason: The study optimizes communication prompts for a referential game between frozen LLMs; no inference efficiency improvement is proposed or measured.

records.title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
records.reason: Mara Chain refines candidate prompts/harness/code configurations during AI-system auto-evolution; its focus is offline optimization of systems, not runtime inference efficiency.

records.title: IndicBankBench: Evaluating Safety and Reliability of Language Model Assistants in Indian Retail Banking
records.reason: IndicBankBench evaluates banking assistant safety, tool use and response adequacy; it is a benchmark rather than an inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
records.reason: Qwen-Planner-Agent is an AI-for-AI mobile-planning framework emphasizing data, training, and real-device task success; no inference resource reduction is described.

records.title: Who Holds the Pen? Let Specifications, Not Agents, Sign Off
records.reason: Who Holds the Pen? evaluates specification compliance and independent authority boundaries for agents; it is not an inference/serving efficiency contribution.
